scope: Runtime-process, per-workspace admission leases for agent exec / search / file-mutation tools. Not an OS-process limit; not a lane or agent fan-out limit.

tests.command: pnpm --dir openclaw_runtime exec node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts src/agents/resource-leases.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools src/agents/tools src/agents/agent-tools

acceptanceResults.criterion: Three concurrent workspaceSearch acquisitions for one key run at most 2 at a time and the third records queuedMs > 0.
acceptanceResults.evidence: openclaw_runtime/src/agents/resource-leases.test.ts: 'caps workspaceSearch at 2 and queues the third with queuedMs > 0'

acceptanceResults.criterion: Overlapping fileMutation keys serialize; disjoint file-mutation keys run in parallel.
acceptanceResults.evidence: resource-leases.test.ts: 'serializes overlapping fileMutation paths and runs disjoint paths in parallel'; production write/edit path delegates via withFileMutationQueue

acceptanceResults.criterion: Overlapping subtreeMutation keys serialize; disjoint subtrees run in parallel.
acceptanceResults.evidence: resource-leases.test.ts: 'serializes overlapping subtreeMutation paths and runs disjoint subtrees in parallel' (kernel-level; no delete/rename agent tool wires this kind yet)

acceptanceResults.criterion: Eight concurrent workspaceExec acquisitions for one key peak at the workspace budget (2), not the lane budget.
acceptanceResults.evidence: resource-leases.test.ts: 'caps 8 concurrent workspaceExec acquisitions at the workspace budget'; bash-workspace-lease.test.ts proves createLocalBashOperations().exec waits on the workspaceExec lease

acceptanceResults.criterion: Release is idempotent and a timed-out waiter leaks no slot.
acceptanceResults.evidence: resource-leases.test.ts: 'releases idempotently without over-admitting the next batch' and 'rejects with a typed timeout error and reclaims the slot after release'

acceptanceResults.criterion: Single-unit + typecheck green; comms green when the communication path is touched.
acceptanceResults.evidence: gates: runtime-agents-vitest (22 files, 221 tests, exit 0), runtime-core-typecheck (exit 0), comms-replay/compare (exit 0)

expectedFailures.name: harness-run-full
expectedFailures.reason: Repo-wide 'Lint without autofix' fails on 3 pre-existing errors in tests/unit/runtime-memory-locomo-full-500.test.ts (indexForReflect / embeddingProviderForReflect unused, retrievedFacts prefer-const), reproduced on origin/main and unrelated to this change. The rules step ('Backend communication boundary scan') passed before the lint step.

limitations: Per runtime process only: it does not bound OS processes, other runtime processes, remote work, or the Electron Main process (which keeps its own workspaceExec lease from #162).

workspaceWriter and subtreeMutation are implemented in the kernel and unit-tested but have no production call site yet: there is no whole-workspace agent operation and no delete / rename / move agent tool.
No performance or hit-rate claim; that would require a stored before/after artifact pair from an agent-driven run.
fileMutation keeps the original unbounded same-file wait; only the new search/exec gates use the 30s default acquire timeout.

readmeReview.note: Runtime-internal admission budget; no user-facing flow, interface, default or documented promise changes.

rawEvidence.note: Raw gate logs and the harness report are retained in the private work dir; this record binds the validated source bytes individually.
